A '''raid above Coruscant''' targeting [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[communications satellite]]s was conducted by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="Xwing" /> in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date" />

Following the expansion of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau's]] network of surveillance satellites into the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], a single [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] was dispatched by the Rebel Alliance to destroy satellites set up in orbit over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]], designated "[[Red One]]," was tasked with destroying the five comm sats and their defenses, heat-seeking [[Mine Type A|mines]] and two [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]] of [[Epsilon group]], in the four [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] before the Imperial [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Sentinel (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Sentinel'']] could respond to the incursion.<ref name="Xwing" />

The engagement was later simulated as a training mission by the Rebel Alliance, intended to teach prospective [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] precision in targeting and navigation. [[Agamarian]] Rebel [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] was assigned to the simulation by [[Training officer/Legends|training officer]] [[Wex Dafid]] prior to Farlander's recruitment into the Alliance [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]{{'s}} [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]].<ref name="XWOSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the [[1993]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] as the third X-wing historical mission, "Satellites near Coruscant."<ref name="Xwing" />
